requirements_summary: SMB support automation platform. Primary want: hosted API POC for ticket summarization and automated ticket creation via tool-calling. Needs structured JSON output (ticket_subject, priority, category, summary, suggested_tags) to feed into their Zendesk workflow. Target latency: p95 < 300ms for summarization path; throughput target ~50 req/min peak, burst to 200/min. Cost sensitive — prefer batching/options to reduce per-token spend. Must support SSO for admin console, audit logs for actions, and retention controls for transcripts.
